label: preparing
what: A bridge or port change at the bakery. Evidence is repeated town gossip reporting an alteration and naming these people as present; however, the reports are hearsay, and the baker explicitly denied witnessing an alteration. There is not enough to establish exactly what change was made or whether all named people knowingly helped. The planned meeting with the neighbour is explicitly described as ordinary and requiring no preparations, so it is not evidence of a concealed joint plan.
